text.tspan: Solid is the mean over every task except the last; faded is the mean over all five.
The gap between a pair is the trade. CompoNet leads before the last task because frozen components cannot be
overwritten, and gives it back over all five because it never learns Q*bert, scoring 0. CLEAR reverses that, its final
game reaching 3.6x its ceiling while everything earlier decayed. Ours is the only pair that is strong on both.
